final_deep_models.selected_reason: Final xAPI model is reverted to the V28/current deep champion because it keeps the strongest Low-class performance among the tested deep xAPI settings.
final_deep_models.evaluation_protocol: Locked test is used only for final evaluation. Low-class threshold tuning is based on CV/OOF probabilities, not locked test.
final_deep_models.baseline_policy: Machine-learning baselines are used only for final comparison, not as teacher, distillation source, pseudo-label source, baseline probability source, or feature-importance source.
